parsing_rationale: The document was parsed by decomposing the 'Core Principles' and 'Technical Requirements' into coding standards and requirements, and the 'Development Workflow' into rules and testing gates. Sections were mapped to the reference template based on their functional purpose (e.g., Workflow -> Branching & PR Workflow).

project_info.brief_explanation: A minimal CLI-based To-Do manager adhering to a simplicity-first philosophy with JSON local storage.
project_info.source_context: Constitution file outlining technical constraints, architecture, and governance.

sections.title: I. Simplicity-First
sections.raw_content:
The application must be minimal and focused. Every feature must justify its existence.
Start simple and resist feature creep. YAGNI (You Aren't Gonna Need It) applies.

sections.title: II. CLI-Only Architecture
sections.raw_content:
The application is a command-line tool only. No web UI, no server, no GUI components.
All functionality must be accessible via command-line arguments and interactive prompts....

sections.title: III. JSON Local Storage
sections.raw_content:
Data is stored in a local JSON file (`todos.json`) in the user's home directory.
No databases, no external services, no network dependencies.

sections.title: IV. Zero Configuration
sections.raw_content:
The application must work out of the box with no setup, no configuration files,
no environment variables, and no installation steps beyond Python.

sections.title: V. Minimal Dependencies
sections.raw_content:
Use Python standard library exclusively. Third-party packages are only acceptable
if they eliminate significant boilerplate or provide critical functionality that
cannot be reasonably implemented in a few lines.

sections.title: Technical Requirements
sections.raw_content:
- Language: Python 3.8+ (standard library only)
- Storage: JSON file at `~/.todos.json`
- Commands: `add`, `list`, `complete`, `remove`, `clear`
- Output: Human-readable by default, JSON format available via `--json` flag

sections.title: Development Workflow
sections.raw_content:
- Code must pass linting with `pylint` or `flake8`
- All functions must have docstrings
- Test coverage must be 80% or higher
- Pull requests require review and passing tests

sections.title: Governance
sections.raw_content:
This constitution supersedes all other practices. Amendments require:
1. Pull request with detailed justification
2. Review by project maintainer
3. Update to this document with version increment

**Version**: 1.0.0 | **Ratified**: 2025-01-09 | **Last Amended**: 2025-01-09

elements.content: Adhere to YAGNI (You Aren't Gonna Need It) and resist feature creep.
Application must be CLI-only; no Web UI, Server, or GUI components.
Data must be stored in a local JSON file (~/.todos.json) with no external dependencies.
Must work out of the box with no setup, config files, or env variables.
Use Python standard library exclusively; third-party packages are exceptions for critical boilerplate reduction.
Code must pass linting with pylint or flake8.
Test coverage must be 80% or higher.
Pull requests require review and passing tests.

structural_gaps.remediation_advice: While a coverage percentage is mentioned in workflow, there is no dedicated section detailing the testing strategy (Unit, Integration, E2E) or the specific test framework used (e.g., pytest).
The document is prescriptive; however, adding a section for known technical debts or future architectural questions would be beneficial.
